data.body:
[P2] Skip invocation retirement evidence when no work was launched

A missing fixture makes `ScenarioDriver.start` raise `NotImplementedError` before creating any invocation or control. Retirement nevertheless builds a nonempty snapshot containing empty attempts and events. The coordinator interprets that snapshot as launched work, rejects its empty inventory, and quarantines the persistent target, blocking remaining cases and subsequent runs. When no invocation or owned resource was created, return quiescent without populating `context.retirement_evidence`. Add a coordinator-level regression with a missing fixture followed by a supported case on the same target.
